confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are medium confidence. They rest on crowd-sourced, partly dated aggregator snapshots (Numbeo data via Expatica from June 2026, Expatistan, and travel guides) and were estimated in euros, then converted to USD at about 1.10 USD per EUR, a cross-rate from a secondary FX source. Cocktail is less certain because the sources are mostly Madrid, Barcelona and club-style pricing used as a proxy. Wine is the most consistent across sources. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates of July peak-season pricing from general knowledge, not from inspected live listings or accommodation searches, so they are low confidence. The FX observation was taken from the RBA homepage/RSS figure reported in search results; the F11.1 table itself was not loaded.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basque coastal tourist city in Spain. Food and drink anchors are based on aggregated Spanish city cost-of-living data, cross-checked against national Spanish guides. Cocktail pricing uses larger Spanish cities as a proxy. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a Spanish coastal city in peak summer season, comparable to other high-demand Spanish resort cities.
